name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Customer Success Manager | B2B SaaS
summary: Customer success and account management professional with 15+ years in SaaS, owning the post-sale relationship from onboarding through adoption, renewal, and growth. Retained ~94% of a 15-20 partner book at Birdeye by monitoring utilization, catching risk early, and running remediation with Product and Engineering. Onboarded 25+ clients a month at Wix at 110% of implementation targets while leading a team of up to 20. Runs business reviews, builds success plans, manages escalations, and represents the company at customer meetings and industry events, with disciplined documentation in Salesforce and HubSpot.
